contracts.setl_values: Author-maintained Library Reference explicitly has value semantics for arbitrarily nested sets/tuples,cardinality # and opaque newat atoms. This is a real set-oriented host,not a certified full countingCPT fragment;arbitrary nesting is a type capability,not a polynomial active-object bound.
contracts.setl_choice: arb returns an arbitrary,not uniformly random,member;empty returns om. Actual l_arb selects first internal table entry via ordsee;from uses set_from and removes an element. Implementation determinism or isomorphism-invariant final Boolean answers do not establish choiceless intermediate states. No orbit-transitivity or history-fixing witness is provided,so this is not WSC by inspection. Table/key/atom allocator internals remain unread.
contracts.setl_order_and_host: String comparisons expose character-code order and tuple comparisons recurse;do not claim opaque atoms have a documented comparison order. newat creates fresh values,which are not simply preexisting input atoms. callout is a C hook whose shipped stub returns om;do not claim that stub already solves rank. Ordinary external procedures/ordered encoding can implement old exact F3 elimination;neither its implementation nor a native rank operator was found/run here.
contracts.setl_resources: pow specifies all 2^|s| subsets;actual l_pow materializes each subset and inserts it,with machine-word 1<<m in this selected implementation. No large-input correctness/overflow claim from this static audit. npow enumerates all k-subsets;fixed k may give polynomial output but arbitrary k or the whole host does not guarantee CPT bounds. The --restricted mode list restricts OS calls,not arb/pow or global polynomial time/active HF objects. Main language-reference file is explicitly a placeholder,not a complete operational semantics.
contracts.souffle_values: Pinned Types manual supports nested and recursively typed records and ADTs;nil is a record base case and nested I/O reads/writes composed records. It is incorrect to describe the whole language as flat bounded-rank Datalog. Typed ordered records/terms are also not automatically extensional unordered HF sets.
contracts.souffle_order_and_host: Symbols are strings with exposed ord numbers that may change across runs. Tutorial autoinc creates identifiers and is forbidden in recursive relations. Arithmetic/ordered comparisons and external C/C++ functors are exposed. Functors must be functional and reentrant,which does not prove permutation equivariance,CPT eligibility or resource bounds. Stateful interface passes SymbolTable/RecordTable pointers;actual runtime RecordTable declares pack/unpack/enumerate. No interpreter or external functor executed.
contracts.souffle_resources: Tutorial warns about nontermination under arithmetic-generated values,while Types documents finite default32/configurable64bit numeric domains. Treat the tutorial Turing-equivalence slogan as an idealized/unbounded semantic warning,not a proof about a particular finite-word build. Recursive records and generated values require separate termination/cardinality/cost arguments. A fixed positive function-free no-new-values relation fragment has at most sum_i n^arity_i possible facts,so standard finite saturation is polynomial for fixed syntax;this source-grounded derivation does not certify arbitrary extensions,aggregates,compiler-generated objects or expose full arbitrary-rank CPT power.
contracts.compiler_gate: A candidate eligible fragment must specify opaque input atoms,permitted constants and full8 input relations;extensional set equality/counting,union,unique-element tests and comprehension;parallel/choiceless iteration semantics;no atom IDs/ord,arbitrary pick,fresh input atoms,host solver or uncharged lazy oracle. Supply a syntax-to-CPT translation preserving Boolean/empty/error behavior and uniform polynomial runtime/active transitive-closure space including temporary/rejected objects. A blacklist or finite relabel test alone is insufficient. This is a required interface specification,not an implemented or certified compiler.
contracts.strong_old_baseline: Q is already decidable on ordinary ordered input encodings by exact F3 elimination,or rank(A)=rank([A|b]);the arbitrary ordering may change the path while preserving the Boolean answer. An order/host-functor/rank-enabled consumer is not excluded by CPT nondefinability. Ordinary flat fixed-arity Datalog is below the full CPT target;old FPC/CFI and already-read preordered-CFI positive algorithm must be compared before claiming any new obstruction. No general GNN,SQL,SETL or Souffle impossibility inferred.
contracts.sparse_gate: No audited interface provides the paper full8-relation charged structures with a verified compact implementation. Finite sparse/lazy evaluator must preserve relation membership and quantification,charge both construction/queries and all represented/temporary objects,hide generator coordinates and charge summary from tested programs,and independently crosscheck F3 consistency and special-case divergence. A generator coordinate tuple,convenient input enumeration or free total-charge oracle changes the permitted information. No memory-feasible witness scale,unknown program-dependent threshold or equivalent HF cost model has been established;this does not prove no feasible implementation exists.
